people.name: Arad
people.line: Arad, Canaanite city, attacked Israel, later inhabited by Kenites

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
translations.kjv: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
